tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS Verification Policy

The project's current recorded decision is that TLS certificate verification is enabled on all builds, including development builds, with no exception for dev. This is reinforced by the recorded decision to use https everywhere with no exceptions, so internal hosts are not exempt either.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/tls-verification.md`. It has one paragraph saying TLS certificate verification is on for all builds, dev included, with no exception. It also says the https-everywhere decision means internal hosts aren't exempt either.

Both statements come from the two current records, #22 (verification on all builds) and #25 (https everywhere, no exceptions). I left out the earlier decision that had dev builds skipping verification, since #22 replaced it.

The first attempt to write the file with a shell command failed with a parser error, so I used the Write tool instead. I did not read the file back afterwards.
